scripts.quality: npm --prefix api run typecheck && npm --prefix web run typecheck && node tools/run-worker-check.mjs compile
scripts.test: npm --prefix api test && npm --prefix web test -- --run && node tools/run-worker-check.mjs test
scripts.contracts: npm --prefix api run test:contract && node tools/run-worker-check.mjs contract
scripts.verify: npm run quality && npm run test && npm run contracts
